# zen-foil

> One <zen-foil> element = one live engraved-hologram plate (WebGPU, WebGL2 fallback, CSS poster without a GPU). Load dist/zen-foil.js once as a module, then write tags. Every option is a plain HTML attribute.

Version 1.1.0. Load once, then write tags:

```html
<script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Bluenot3/alex-leschik@f8129c60668b77bb8332de356b4c2d9bbc648221/skills/zen-foil/dist/zen-foil.js"></script>
<zen-foil scene="seal" mark="zen" headline="ZEN AI CO" subline="ISSUED UNDER SEAL"
  serial="ZEN-2026-"></zen-foil>
```

## Rules

- Load zen-foil.js exactly once, from one URL, as <script type="module">. Pin the CDN to a commit (@<sha>), not @main.
- Use only scene ids and attributes listed here. Anything else is ignored, so check with ZenFoil.check() or scripts/verify.mjs.
- Points are "lon,lat; lon,lat" with longitude first (Washington, D.C. is -77.04,38.91).
- Engraved text is short, UPPERCASE and true. Never invent figures, partners or credentials: leave the attribute out instead.
- Brand params default to ZEN AI Co. copy. For any other brand set every brandParams entry, or remove ZEN marks with mark="none" where allowed.
- One hero plate per viewport, at most ~8 plates on screen, field backgrounds at low density (0.15–0.3).
- Real headings and copy stay in the DOM next to the plate (SEO, accessibility); the plate is the visual.
- The plate's height comes from the scene's aspect ratio unless your CSS sets a height; give it a width (it is display:block, full width).

## Scenes

- `seal`: Guilloche medallion around a brand mark, ring microprint, a stamping pulse and a live credential serial. Params: mark, layout, counter, speed, headline, subline, micro, serial, caption, eyebrow.
- `globe`: Engraved Earth turning under a holographic atmosphere; great-circle arcs carry your mark from an origin to every destination. Params: origin, points, mark, partner, layout, spin, hubs, headline, subline, label, micro, stat.
- `usmap`: Engraved U.S. map; arcs spread from an origin under your seal, and each arrival issues the next credential serial. Params: origin, points, mark, counter, cycle, label, micro, headline, serial, caption.
- `banner`: Interlaced guilloche waves across a wide band, a cartouche headline, end seals and edge microprint. Params: mark, strands, speed, headline, subline, micro.
- `certificate`: Guilloche-bordered credential: title, recipient, program, date, serial and a gold seal. Paper or holographic. Params: mark, speed, headline, recipient, program, date, serial, issuer, micro, presented.
- `metric`: A decoding headline figure over an engraved, foil-lined chart of your series, with a live read head. Params: value, label, delta, headline, micro, series, mark, speed.
- `network`: Your mark as an orchestrating hub with labelled agents on an engraved orbit and packets streaming along the links. Params: nodes, mark, speed, headline, subline, status, micro.
- `engrave`: Turns any image into a holographic banknote engraving; reveal mode adds a full-colour loupe that follows the pointer. Params: src, mark, mode, frame, density, headline, subline, micro.
- `stage`: Gallery that mints each image in through its own engraved lines, over a blurred copy of itself, with sheen and microprint. Params: images, src, interval, top, bottom.
- `vault`: Ray-traced glass cube with dispersion, your images (or video) printed on its faces, and engraved seals until they load. Params: images, mark, spin, tilt, scrollspin, frame, ring.
- `field`: Page-background field of floating cipher glyphs with parallax, sheen, watermark seals and decoding phrases. Params: variant, density, rate, seals, phrases.
- Portfolio plates (load `zen-foil-showcase.js` from the same place): `pioneer`, `dmv`, `near`, `parks`, `spark`, `gallery`, `stem`, `medcode`, `cipher`, `terminal`, `planet`, `proto`, `weekly`, `forge`, `lens`, `gravity`, `toon`, `chronos`, `deadline`, `baker`.

## Element attributes

- `scene`: Required. Which scene to draw (see scenes).
- `accent`: Any CSS colour: #hex, rgb(), hsl(var(--primary)), oklch(). One per plate, from the brand.
- `theme`: plate (dark, default), paper (light security paper) or clear (ink only, over your own background). Ignored by raw/alpha scenes.
- `aria-label`: Accessible name. Without it the plate is decorative.
- `fixed`: Full-viewport background layer (use with scene="field").
- `seed`: Fixes the plate's random phase.
- `max-dpr`: Device-pixel-ratio ceiling (1–3). Use 1.25–1.5 for big background layers.
- `class`: CSS classes. On the raw element in React 18 write class, not className.
- `style`: Inline CSS. The height comes from the scene's aspect unless CSS sets one.
